pages.heading: How the HR Desk Works
pages.body: For Nile Logistics and similar growing teams: a clear view of how outsourced HR operations can support payroll and onboarding.

pages.heading: Why teams reach this point
pages.body:
When a company grows, HR work grows with it. Payroll, employee onboarding, and day-to-day admin can start taking time away from planning, manager support, and hiring.

For teams with 30 to 300 staff, this often happens before a full internal operations team is in place. An outsourced HR operations desk gives you a dedicated way to handle the recurring work without building everything from scratch.

items.title: Payroll runs
items.text: We manage the recurring payroll workflow, checks, and coordination needed to keep pay cycles moving.

items.title: Onboarding support
items.text: We help structure employee onboarding so new starters get the right setup and information on time.

items.title: HR admin
items.text: We take on routine HR operations tasks that otherwise sit with a busy people or finance team.

items.title: Clear handoffs
items.text: We align with your internal team on what stays in-house and what the desk handles.

pages.heading: Why this is relevant now
pages.body:
Nile Logistics currently lists four open payroll and HR administrator vacancies on its careers page. That is a clear sign that these responsibilities are active and worth organizing.

The company also says it opened 3 new warehouses in Alexandria this year. Growth like that usually increases coordination needs across payroll, onboarding, and HR administration. An outsourced desk can help create structure while the team keeps expanding.

items.title: Review needs
items.text: We look at your current payroll and onboarding process and identify where support is needed.

items.title: Define scope
items.text: We agree which HR operations tasks the desk will run and which tasks stay with your team.

items.title: Set rhythm
items.text: We establish the regular cadence for handovers, updates, and approvals.

items.title: Operate and adjust
items.text: We run the process, keep communication clear, and refine the workflow as needs change.

pages.heading: What you get
pages.body:
The goal is not to replace your people team. It is to give it reliable operational support so routine work does not slow growth.

That means a clearer process for payroll and onboarding, less admin pressure on your internal team, and a simpler way to scale HR operations as headcount rises.
